## Constraints & Preferences
- **Only work on Expo Go native app** — freeze all other apps (Kotlin `android-ivx-holdings/`, iOS `ios-ivx-holdings/`)
- Do NOT ask owner to paste credentials in chat — credentials must be found via code audit or injected via env widget
- Do NOT treat every missing variable as a blocker — audit each credential individually
- Do NOT require AWS for non-AWS deployment stages — AWS is optional (APK upload only)
- Never print secret values in logs or API responses
- Owner has AWS MFA lockout — cannot fix AWS credentials until next week
- Owner wants APK download via regular URL, not S3 — suggested Vercel landing page as alternative
- Brand standardization is PAUSED — owner redirected to full agent audit, then to chat fix
- IVX IA must distinguish 5 answer types: diagnostic, code-change, deployment, task-status, general explanation
- Diagnostic requests must NEVER be routed to the worker — they must return a real diagnosis with files, functions, root cause, and fix
- Progress cards may remain but must show real evidence per stage, not just percentages
- No false COMMITTING status — stage validation required before advancing

## Progress
### Done
- **12-agent deep QA audit COMPLETED** — Final certification: NOT VERIFIED, 0/12 verified as real independent senior developer agents; 12 executive labels share one Node.js process; P0 failures documented

- **`ivxChatDiagnosticEngine.ts` CREATED** — Inspects real chat loading path (12 steps from app open to composer ready); probes live production API; identifies root cause with exact files/functions; produces structured DIAGNOSIS/FIX/DEPLOYMENT/VERIFICATION card
- **`chat.tsx` UPDATED** — Injected `classifyOwnerIntent()` BEFORE `isSeniorDeveloperBuildRequest()` check; diagnostic branch runs `runChatDiagnostic()` with live progress cards; status branch returns task status; explanation falls through to AI; build-intent now gated by `ownerIntent.routesToWorker`
- **`ivxOwnerIntentClassifier.test.ts` CREATED** — 25+ test cases covering all 5 intent classes + owner's exact prompt regression test

- **Re-running intent classifier tests** after pattern fix to confirm all 25+ pass
- **Running lint/typecheck** on modified `chat.tsx` and new files
- **Implementing chat loading UX fixes** (cached shell, skeleton placeholders, parallelized queries) per owner directive sections 7-11

- Diagnostic intent takes PRIORITY over deployment/code-change intent — a message starting with "audit" or "why is" is diagnostic even if it ends with "deploy it"

FROM oven/bun:1.2-alpine AS server-deps
WORKDIR /app

# NOTE: bun.lock is intentionally NOT required here. The GitHub sync pipeline
# (expo/sync-github.mjs) ignores bun.lock, so the lockfile in this repo can lag
# package.json (e.g. when a new dep like `unpdf` is added). `--frozen-lockfile`
# would then abort the build (the exact cause of prod being stuck on an old
# commit). Resolve fresh from package.json instead so new deps always install.
COPY package.json ./
RUN bun install --production

# Node 22 ships a native global WebSocket (Node 20 does not). @supabase/supabase-js
# initializes a Realtime WebSocket client in its constructor, so on Node 20 every
# createClient() call threw "Node.js 20 detected without native WebSocket support"
# before any owner-gated request could run. Node 22 (LTS) provides WebSocket natively.
FROM node:22-alpine AS runner
WORKDIR /app

# ffmpeg + ffprobe power the IVX video pipeline (HLS transcode ladder, thumbnails,
# posters) in backend/services/ivx-video-pipeline.ts and unlock the video worker
# (backend/services/ivx-video-worker.ts). Alpine's ffmpeg package ships both binaries.
RUN apk add --no-cache ffmpeg

# Chromium + deps power the IVX Browser Automation QA service. The install is
# intentionally non-fatal: if the Alpine package names/versions don't align with
# the current node:22-alpine base image, the container still builds successfully
# and the QA service degrades gracefully to status-only until the browser is
# available. The QA engine points to the system Chromium path and uses
# --no-sandbox / --disable-setuid-sandbox (required for the non-root Render runtime).
# NOTE: package names vary across Alpine versions (font-noto-emoji vs noto-fonts-emoji,
# ttf-freefont vs font-freefont). Try the known set, then a smaller fallback set.
RUN apk add --no-cache chromium nss freetype harfbuzz fontconfig font-noto-emoji font-freefont ttf-freefont noto-fonts-emoji 2>/dev/null \
    || apk add --no-cache chromium nss freetype harfbuzz fontconfig font-noto-emoji 2>/dev/null \
    || apk add --no-cache chromium nss freetype harfbuzz fontconfig noto-fonts-emoji 2>/dev/null \
    || apk add --no-cache chromium nss freetype harfbuzz fontconfig 2>/dev/null \
    || echo "[IVX-QA] Optional Chromium install failed; QA service will run in status-only mode"
ENV PLAYWRIGHT_CHROMIUM_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium

ENV NODE_ENV=production
ENV PORT=3000
ENV HOST=0.0.0.0

# NOTE: we deliberately do NOT copy the `bun` binary into this Node runner.
# A hard `COPY --from=server-deps /usr/local/bin/bun ...` is FATAL if the source
# path differs between bun image versions, which froze production on the last-good
# image (the landing-SEO auto-deployer never ran). The autonomous lifecycle's

| Layer | File | Bug |

| Backend | `ivx-owner-ai-intent-router.ts` | `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock()` counted "deploy"+"fix" as 2 execution signals → routed to worker |

**Client (committed `b8d06f7c`, 2860 insertions):**
- `ivxOwnerIntentClassifier.ts` — 5-class intent detection (diagnostic, code_change, deployment, status, explanation); diagnostic takes priority over deploy/fix

- `ivx-owner-ai-intent-router.ts` — added `isDiagnosticLeadingIntent()` guard at top of `isOwnerExecutionOrTaskBlock()`; prompts leading with audit/diagnose/explain/why-is + a loading symptom are NEVER routed to the worker
- `ivx-owner-ai-intent-router.test.ts` — 7 new regression tests including the owner's exact prompt
